title: Ensuring Compliance with Ethnic Integration Policy when HDB Flats are Rented Out
what_it_is: Ensuring Compliance with Ethnic Integration Policy when HDB Flats are Rented Out

sections.label: HDB rental ethnic policy checks
sections.summary: Tenants renting HDB flats on the open market are not subject to the Ethnic Integration Policy, but flat owners renting to non-citizens must meet the Non-Citizen Quota and seek HDB approval.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: asked the Minister for National Development (a) how does HDB ensure that the Ethnic Integration Policy (EIP) is adhered to when the flat owners rent out their flats; (b) whether there are rules in place to ensure compliance with this policy when flats are rented out; and (c) if so, whether HDB conducts checks or assessments to ensure that the sanctity of the EIP is maintained.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: But tenants who rent HDB flats out on the open market are not subject to the EIP, as their stays are typically temporary in nature and do not affect the ethnic proportions in our public housing estates in the longer term.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Instead, flat owners who rent out their flats to one or more non-citizen tenants are subject to the Non-Citizen Quota.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: All HDB owners are required to seek HDB's approval and ensure that they meet the quota before renting out their flats.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: HDB conducts regular inspections of flats to ensure that all flat owners adhere to HDB's regulations.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Unauthorised renting out of HDB flats is a serious infringement of the lease, and HDB will take firm action against any errant flat owners.

sections.label: Non-citizen quotas set 2014
sections.summary: The quotas set for non-citizens were put in place in 2014.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: The quotas that were set for non-citizens were put in place in 2014.

sections.label: Bukit Batok East quota monitoring
sections.summary: The quota was set in 2014, no breach has occurred in Bukit Batok East, numbers are within quotas, and monitoring will continue.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: So, we have set the quota in place in 2014.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: So far, there has not been any breach of the quota for the neighbourhood in Bukit Batok East.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: What we have seen is that the numbers are well within the quotas that we have set.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: But we will continue to monitor and see, as we progress along, whether there is a need to update and review these limits.
